page: Amazon Web Services r7i.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System. It features 64 vCPUs and 32 physical cores utilizing the x86_64 architecture with Intel Xeon 8488C processors running at 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance across memory-intensive and computational tasks. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 19182.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 72798.2. Memory bandwidth is a key strength, with read-only large block bandwidth reaching 216.54 GB/sec and small block cached read bandwidth at 4746.46 GB/sec. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to strong performance in image processing and LLM inference, processing 259.02 tokens per second for medium 7B model prompts.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r7i.16xlarge offers a high density of DDR5 memory relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without the overhead of local NVMe storage. It is highly suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching platforms like Redis, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
